turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, am I speaking with Mr. Sharma of Kolkata?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, this is Sharma. Who is calling please?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: My name is Anjali from Global Connect. I am calling to share a special offer on our high-speed broadband plans for your area.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Broadband? I already have a connection, beta. I do not need another one.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I understand, sir. This plan is much faster and includes a free security upgrade for your devices.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I am not very good with computers. How much does this cost?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: The annual subscription for this premium package comes to nine thousand five hundred rupees, including tax.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: That is quite a lot of money for me. I must ask my son first.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: That is perfectly fine, sir. I can send the complete brochure and plan details to your email or WhatsApp.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, please do that. I will check it and let you know later.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I will send it right away. Thank you for your time, Mr. Sharma.
